Challenge_SecretZ_desc: All this years of hard work wasted, this has become a real mess, a really big mess, but maybe is not late, yet. <LINE> <LINE> Operators were sent to every Research Facility for retrieving to the last vital document, sample, and person who is in this mess, and of course which can be useful for the Government and only god knows for who more, but... there are more interests than we even know. Every Team has his own mission, keep that in mind. The Trust is becoming something difficult to find these days. <LINE> <LINE> You lost contact with your Team members and the other Teams radios are silent, so you are alone in this, but the objective must be accomplished at all cost, no matter what, follow the orders and get the job done, this is what we do.<LINE> <LINE> The situation went out of hands here, then the Security System did his job, somehow, if we can call it that way, so you are trapped here, and you shouldn't find a way out until you find the objective, anyway someone of your Team should have the security keycard to open the access gate.<LINE> <LINE> Thanks for Playing! <LINE>
Challenge_GrowingUp_desc: You are 8 years old. No skills, no occupation. <LINE> Every 90 days you age one year. Drive at 14, grow up at 18.
Challenge_FallOutStart_desc: War. War Never Changes. <LINE> <LINE> You Stand At A turning Point in Human History, Where once There Was Mankinds Strength in Manufacturing, Prosperity & Technological Innovation, Now What Remains Lies In Ruin <LINE> <LINE>  ...... <LINE> <LINE> This is yet Another Bloody Chapter Of Human History <LINE> <LINE> You Have 12 Hours. Seek Shelter. Or Persist No Longer In This Doomed Reality. The Choice, Dweller. Is Yours. <LINE> <LINE> Project Fallout Story ~ Mode Scenario <LINE> <LINE> [REQUIRED MODS] <LINE> [Project Fallout The Armory] <LINE> [Project Fallout: GunRunner]
Challenge_AbandonedSoldier_desc: Your squad is missing, and the gunfire has drawn a nearby horde to your rendezvous point.
Challenge_DodgeballofTheDead_desc: A concussion after a dodgeball game leaves you dodging more than balls to survive.
Challenge_EnterAreaChallenge_desc: After months on the road, you have reached the outskirts of Knox Country.
Challenge_FireSale_desc: A routine looting run to the mall gets dangerously hot. All sales are final.
Challenge_HospitalChallenge_desc: You wake up in hospital tired, hungry, thirsty, drunk, and with a broken bone.
Challenge_LastDitchSecurity_desc: You blew the dormitory stairs, but the blast has drawn a nearby horde.
Challenge_NakedAndAfraid_desc: You wake up with nothing in a cabin or vacant building, absolutely terrified.
Challenge_PrisonChallenge_desc: Locked up for something you did not do, with a smuggled tool and one chance to break out.
Challenge_TheLastFlight_desc: Your aircraft has crash-landed far from civilisation. Start as an injured pilot with emergency supplies nearby.
Challenge_TheTestSubject_desc: You wake beneath a military base. Escape its infected underground complex before it consumes you.
